method: SCANNED two-page spreads (no text layer): each pdf page = two printed pages, pdf = floor(printed/2)+6 (printed p. 1 = right half of pdf 6). Printed contents p. v (pdf 3) read from images; chapter/section starts verified visually at pdf 6, 12, 24, 27, 64, 66, 71, 81, 93, 149, 181, 192, 200. Each chapter's 'Reflections' essay is level 1 under its chapter; ch. 5 (pdf 64-111 with its Reflections, 48 pdf pages) also split at its four section headings. A chapter's first pdf page also carries the last printed page of the previous chapter on its left half. Complete MIT Press paperback (7th printing 1998), pp. v-388.
